description: Defines the MediaTransform class for managing IMFTransform objects, including state management, type setting, message sending, and error handling, specifically for Windows media processing.

classes.name: MediaTransform
classes.description: A wrapper class for IMFTransform that manages media processing states, input/output types, messaging, and error states for Windows media transforms.

methods.name: MediaTransform
methods.description: Constructor initializing MediaTransform with CLSID or existing IMFTransform.

methods.name: EnableInputThrottle
methods.description: Enables or disables input throttling based on transform needs.

methods.name: TryWrite
methods.description: Attempts to write an input sample to the transform.

methods.name: TryRead
methods.description: Attempts to read an output sample from the transform.

methods.name: Drain
methods.description: Signals the transform to process remaining data.

methods.name: draining
methods.description: Returns whether the transform is currently draining.

methods.name: drained
methods.description: Returns whether the transform has been drained.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the transform has encountered an error.

methods.name: ResetFromDrained
methods.description: Resets the transform to accept new input after draining.

methods.name: HasValidTransform
methods.description: Checks if the underlying IMFTransform is valid.

methods.name: GetCurrentInputType
methods.description: Retrieves the current input media type.

methods.name: SetInputType
methods.description: Sets the input media type.

methods.name: GetAvailableInputTypes
methods.description: Gets all available input media types.

methods.name: GetCurrentOutputType
methods.description: Retrieves the current output media type.

methods.name: SetOutputType
methods.description: Sets the output media type.

methods.name: GetAvailableOutputTypes
methods.description: Gets all available output media types.

methods.name: SetOutputTypeBySubType
methods.description: Sets output type by subtype GUID.

methods.name: GetAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the IMFAttributes of the transform.

methods.name: GetOutputStreamAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves stream-specific attributes.

methods.name: GetSampleProtection
methods.description: Gets sample protection interface.

methods.name: GetStreamCount
methods.description: Retrieves input and output stream counts.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the IMFTransform.

methods.name: GetTransformCreateError
methods.description: Returns error message if transform creation failed.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the transform to its initial state.
